name: OMNIPHI CASINO NETWORK: Neural Floor Edition
description: The dominant legal gambling platform in GLMZ, OMNIPHI delivers full-sensory casino environments directly through BCI — players feel the weight of chips, smell recycled air, experience the micro-tension of a dealer's pause without leaving their hab. Licensed under Sable Charter Article 44, the Network processes an estimated Φ2.3 billion in wagers annually across 140 licensed neural floors spanning Tiers 2 through 5. The Spire's private neural rooms offer bespoke high-stakes environments indistinguishable from physical presence, while Tier 2 access nodes run stripped-down versions from converted bar booths.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 accountant discovers their BCI has been logging their OMNIPHI emotional data and selling it to a corponation's behavioral prediction market.
An underground collective is selling 'cold floor' BCI patches that strip the emotional amplification from OMNIPHI sessions — the network wants them gone.
A high-stakes neural room player keeps winning in ways that shouldn't be statistically possible, and the casino's security team suspects a BCI exploit no one has catalogued yet.
